title: Under Construction
subject: internet-culture
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: The web before it tidied itself up: hand-coded pages, animated dividers, and a spinning envelope for mail.

entries.clue: Browser whose 1995 flotation started the rush
Free homepage host that filed its users into neighbourhoods
Face assembled out of punctuation, read sideways
Loop of sites joined by next and previous buttons
Rectangular advertisement stretched across the top
Board of threaded posts, Roman in name
Newsgroup system older than the web it outlived on
Online journal, named by clipping a longer compound
File format behind those looping homepage tunes

factCards.text: Netscape Communications went public on 9 August 1995; the share price closed far above its offer price and the day is often cited as the start of the dot-com boom.
factCards.sourceTitle: US Securities and Exchange Commission — Netscape Communications registration filings, 1995

factCards.text: Scott Fahlman proposed the sideways smiley on a Carnegie Mellon bulletin board on 19 September 1982; the original post was recovered from backup tapes in 2002.
factCards.sourceTitle: Carnegie Mellon University — Original Bboard Thread archive

factCards.text: GeoCities closed its main service in 2009. Figures for how many pages were lost vary by archive and are not reproduced here as a single number.
